definitions.explanation: Hair cut short, especially a short men's cut. A slightly written word: in conversation people usually say {髪|かみ}が{短|みじか}い or ショート (for women).

examples.japanese: {短髪|たんぱつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧。
{短髪|たんぱつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{似合|にあ}う→似合う：02134_niau⟧。

⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{短髪|たんぱつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{身長|しんちょう}→身長：03263_shinchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{百七十|ひゃくななじゅう}⟦センチ→センチ：01372_senchi⟧⟦ぐらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見|み}られている→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: The culprit is believed to be a man with short hair, about 170 centimetres tall.

notes:
USAGE:
Common in descriptions of people: news reports, wanted notices, profiles and job ads ({短髪|たんぱつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{清潔感|せいけつかん}→清潔感：31788_seiketsukan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧, short-haired and clean-cut). Its opposite is {長髪|ちょうはつ} (long hair).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ショート→ショート：10951_shooto⟧ヘア / ⟦ショート→ショート：10951_shooto⟧: short hair, mainly of women's styles
- ⟦{坊主頭|ぼうずあたま}→坊主頭：32951_bouzuatama⟧: a head clipped close all over
- ⟦{刈|か}り{上|あ}げ→刈り上げ：32992_kariage⟧: back and sides cropped short

WATCH OUT:
The homophone ⟦{単発|たんぱつ}→単発：20543_tanpatsu⟧ means "one-off, single-shot".
